summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Einride AB, a foreign private issuer, reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting held on June 30, 2026. Shareholders approved all proposals, and the board subsequently appointed R. Lynn Atchison to the audit and nominations committees. The filing discloses the updated composition of the audit, compensation, and nominations committees. This is a routine shareholder meeting report with no special-situations event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring. No deal terms are present.
